newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan steel firms to supply Marubeni Brazil pipes.
newsitem.headline: Japan steel firms to supply Marubeni Brazil pipes.

text.p: Marubeni Corp said on Thursday that it would procure steel pipes for a natural gas pipeline project linking Bolivia and Brazil from four Japanese steel makers.
The four steel makers are Nippon Steel Corp, NKK Corp, Kawasaki Steel Corp and Sumitomo Metal Industries Ltd, a Marubeni spokesman said.

The Japanese trading house formed a consortium with the Brazilian steel-pipe maker Confab Industrial SA and won an order from Brazil's Petroleo Brazileiro SA to supply steel pipes worth about $600 million, he said.
The construction of the 3,200-km pipeline will start in July and its completion is set for January 2000, a Marubeni spokesman said.
Marubeni plans to extend a $100 million loan to help finance the project, the spokesman said.
The Export-Import Bank of Japan also plans to extend a loan of $400 million to the project, he said.
